item.tib: zhi khro bar do thos grol gyi las byang 'bring po bag chags rang grol gyi lag len gsal byed sgron me
item.coloph: ces zhi khro bar do thos grol gyi/ gzhung 'bring po bag chags rang grol gyi lag len gsal byed sgron me 'di yang / dbang phyug ces pa me mo glang gi 'dod 'phel zla ba'i dmar phyogs su/ shar rdza a khod dar rgyas gling gi yang dben ri khrod brag gi bya skyibs su/ snyigs dus kyi rnal 'byor pa kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po 'bod pa'i (pas) brtsams pa bstan 'gro'i smin yon du gyur cig/
